title: Miss Supranational 2026 Katrina Llegado's victory celebration pushed to Sept. 19
summary: After inclement weather derailed the scheduled celebration of Katrina Llegado’s Miss Supranational victory twice, the reigning queen is set to have two victory parades on Saturday, Sept. 19.…

blocks.text: After inclement weather derailed the scheduled celebration of Katrina Llegado’s Miss Supranational victory twice, the reigning queen is set to have two victory parades on Saturday, Sept. 19. The first leg of the festivities will be her homecoming parade in Taguig City. It will kick off at the Bagumbayan Hall at 9 a.m., and will end at Ayala Malls Arca South, where a homecoming celebration is scheduled at 10 a.m. Llegado is expected to greet her fellow Taguigenos as her parade traverses the streets in Bagumbayan, Lower Bicutan, New Lower Bicutan, Hagonoy, Central Signal, South Signal and, finally, at Arca South.
